بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
الموصولات الحرفية
blocks.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Kind. Al-mawsoolaat al-harfiyyah
Al-mawsoolaat al-harfiyyah (bi-ta'weel al-masdar, bi-ta'weel al-mufrad)
The six particles shown (the last two printed in grey):
items: أَنْ
كَيْ
أَنّ
مَا
لَوْ
أَ
The above 6 words are known as {{term|الموصولات الحرفية}}.
These words also belong to other groups based on other governing factors and methods of usage.

However, they are grouped here as الموصولات الحرفية because they are "particles" which are "connected" to a sentence i.e., they {{ruling|enter upon a sentence}}. This sentence is known as a {{term|صلة}} meaning "connection".

They restructure the sentence into a compound/phrase. More specifically, into a {{ruling|مركب إضافي}} with the usage of a {{ruling|مصدر}}. The purpose of this is to enable the sentence to fall into places of {{ruling|مفرد}}, i.e., be مبتدا, فاعل, مفعول به etc. This is why they are also known as {{term|"السابكة"}} "The forming one", "The structuring one".
This process is called {{term|"بِتَأْويلِ المصدر – بِتَأْويلِ المفرد"}} with the interpretation into مصدر or مفرد. Abbreviation: {{term|BTM}}
The interpreted مصدر is called {{term|"المصدر المُؤَوَّل"}} The interpreted مصدر or {{term|"المصدر المَسْبُوْك"}} The formed مصدر.
Some can enter upon a جملة إسمية and some on a جملة فعلية.

blocks.en: An

items: أن is termed as {{term|المصدرية الناصبة}}.
It connects i.e., enters upon a {{condition|جملة فعلية}}. More specifically, it enters upon a verb.
The verb can be a {{condition|ماضي}} verb or a {{condition|مضارع}} verb.
If the verb is a {{condition|مضارع}}, أن will also make the مضارع verb {{ruling|منصوب}}.
It will interpret the جملة فعلية into a {{ruling|مفرد}}.
The interpreted construction will generally be a فاعل, مفعول به, مبتدا, مضاف إليه or مجرور.

blocks.en: This is done by:
items: a) Identifying the {{term|مصدر}} of the verb.
b) Identifying the نائب الفاعل/فاعل of the verb.
c) Extracting the نائب الفاعل/فاعل from the verb {{condition|if it's a ضمير}}.
d) Making the مصدر {{ruling|مضاف}} of the نائب الفاعل/فاعل.
e) Ensuring what used to be the نائب الفاعل/فاعل is in the state of {{ruling|جر}} as a {{ruling|مضاف إليه}}.

blocks.en: Steps shown beside the first example (مصدر and مضاف in red, the rest in green):
items: a) Identify the مصدر.
b) Identify the نائب الفاعل/فاعل.
c) Extract the نائب الفاعل/فاعل if it's a ضمير.
d) Make the مصدر مضاف to the نائب الفاعل/فاعل.
e) Ensure مضاف إليه is مجرور.

items: A Masdar can {{ruling|behave like a verb}} under certain circumstances.

blocks.ar: غَضِبُوْا بِأَنْ كُسِرَ الأَصْنَامُ يَوْمَ العِيْدِ
blocks.en: They became angry that the idols were broken on the day of the festival.
the breaking of the idols on the day of the festival
Beside the first example:
items: Quite often, أن is {{term|dropped}} from the sentence. Despite It being visibly absent, it is {{ruling|assumed to be present}}.
Its presence is evident by its governing which manifests on the {{condition|مضارع}} verb.
It's dropped after certain حروف. I will mention 2 here, the first being {{condition|لِ}}.

blocks.en: I learn nahw so that I understand the Qur'an.
my understanding the Qur'an
Beside the second example:
items: Quite often, أن is {{term|dropped}} from the sentence. Despite It being visibly absent, it is {{ruling|assumed to be present}}.
Its presence is evident by its governing which manifests on the {{condition|مضارع}} verb.
It's dropped after certain حروف. I will mention 2 here, the second being {{condition|حَتّٰى}}.

blocks.en: I learn the Qur'an so that I enter Paradise. ((أن) is printed small, in yellow, before أَدْخُلَ.)
my entering Paradise
Beside the first example:
items: When a نفي is present on the verb, the نفي will be {{ruling|rephrased as an إسم}}.
The إسم will be made {{ruling|مضاف}} to the مصدر. This is done for the retention of the negation present in the original sentence.
The إسم used here is: {{term|عَدَمٌ}} (not, absence).

blocks.ar: أَنْ لَّا تَحْضُرَ فِي الفَصْلِ مُضِرٌّ لَكَ
blocks.en: That you do not attend the class is harmful for you.
your not attending the class
Beside the second example:
items: If the اللام after which the أن is dropped, is {{condition|combined with a نفي}}, then the أن {{ruling|must be present}} in the sentence. It will not be dropped.
However, the أن will {{ruling|integrate into the لا النافية}} when written as seen in the example.

blocks.ar: أَتَعَلَّمُ النَّحْوَ لِـئَـلَّا أَغْفُلَ عَنِ القُرْآنِ
blocks.en: I learn nahw so that I am not heedless of the Qur'an.
my not being heedless of the Qur'an
Kay

items: كي is also termed as {{term|المصدرية الناصبة}}.
It also connects to a {{term|جملة فعلية}}. More specifically, it enters upon a verb.
The verb must only be a {{condition|مضارع}} verb.
It will make the مضارع verb {{ruling|منصوب}}.
It will interpret the جملة فعلية into a {{term|مفرد}}.
The interpreted construction will only be {{ruling|مجرور}}.
This is because there is always a {{term|اللام حرف الجر}} which is for تعليل (reason) before it.
This اللام can be explicit in the sentence or dropped but must be assumed, hence the meaning of {{term|تعليل}} is always present.
The method of interpreting the sentence into a مفرد is the same as what was previously mentioned in أَنْ.

blocks.en: I accepted Islam so that I may enter Paradise

items: a) Identify the {{term|مصدر}}.
b) Identify the {{term|فاعل/نائب الفاعل}}.
c) Extract the فاعل/نائب الفاعل if it's a {{condition|ضمير}}.
d) Make the مصدر {{label|مضاف}} to the فاعل/نائب الفاعل.
e) Ensure مضاف إليه is {{ruling|مجرور}}.

blocks.en: my entering Paradise
The اللام حرف الجر can be {{condition|present}} in the sentence.

blocks.ar: أَصُوْمُ كَيْ يَغْفِرَ اللهُ لِيْ ذَنْبِيْ
blocks.en: I fast so that Allah may forgive me my sin

items: a) Identify the {{term|مصدر}}.
b) Identify the {{term|فاعل/نائب الفاعل}}.
c) Extract the فاعل/نائب الفاعل if it's a {{condition|ضمير}}.
d) Make the مصدر {{label|مضاف}} to the فاعل/نائب الفاعل.
e) Ensure مضاف إليه is {{ruling|مجرور}}.

blocks.en: Allah's forgiving me my sin
The اللام حرف الجر can be {{condition|absent}} but must be assumed.
I accepted Islam so that I may not enter the Fire
my not entering the Fire

items: A {{term|نفي}} can be added to the verb and as mentioned in أن, it will be interpreted with {{term|عدم}}.

If the اللام حرف الجر is present in the sentence with the لا النافية, then the 3 i.e., the اللام حرف الجر, the كي and the لا النافية will be {{ruling|written together like one word}} as seen in the example.

blocks.en: The student strove so that he may not fail
his not failing

items: With the presence of a {{condition|نفي}}, it is permissible to drop the اللام حرف الجر.
When the اللام حرف الجر is dropped, then the remaining 2 i.e., the كي and the لا النافية will be {{ruling|written separately}} as seen in the example.

blocks.en: Anna

items: أَنَّ is termed as {{term|الحرف المشبهة بالفعل}}.
أَنَّ connects to a {{term|جملة إسمية}}. More specifically, it enters upon a مبتدا and خبر.
It will change the مبتدا from مرفوع to {{ruling|منصوب}}. The مبتدا will be known as {{term|إسمُ أَنَّ}} (Ism of أَنَّ).
The خبر will remain {{ruling|مرفوع}}. However, the خبر will be known as {{term|خبرُ أَنَّ}} (خبر of أَنَّ).
It will interpret the جملة إسمية into a {{term|مفرد}}.
The interpreted construction will generally be a {{ruling|فاعل, مفعول به, مبتدا or مجرور}}.
The method of interpreting the sentence into a مفرد depends on the construction of the جملة إسمية.
Ultimately, the construction of the جملة إسمية will fall into 3 types.
The details are as follows:

blocks.en: If the خبر أَنَّ is a {{condition|مشتق}}, a {{condition|مصدر}} or a verb.
Allah rewards you because you are obedient to your parents
your obedience to your parents

items: a) Identify the {{term|مصدر}} of the خبر أَنَّ.
b) Make the مصدر {{label|مضاف}} to the إسم أَنَّ.
c) Ensure مضاف إليه is {{ruling|مجرور}}.

blocks.en: If the خبر أَنَّ is a {{condition|مشتق}}, a {{condition|مصدر}} or a verb.

items: a) Identify the {{term|مصدر}} of the خبر أَنَّ.
b) Make the مصدر {{label|مضاف}} to the إسم أَنَّ.

b) Make the مصدر {{label|مضاف}} to the إسم أَنَّ.
c) Ensure مضاف إليه is {{ruling|مجرور}}.

blocks.en: Option 1
If the خبر أَنَّ is an {{condition|إسم جامد}}.

Muhammad's being His slave

items: a) We will use the word {{term|كان}} because It's Masdar can govern like its verb.
b) Identify the {{term|مصدر}} of كان.
c) Make the مصدر {{label|مضاف}} to the إسم أَنَّ.
d) Make the خبر أَنَّ the خبر of the مصدر of كان.
e) Ensure مضاف إليه is {{ruling|مجرور}} and خبر كَوْن is {{ruling|منصوب}}.

items: a) Convert the خبر أَنَّ into a {{term|المصدر الصناعي}}.
b) The المصدر الصناعي can serve as a {{term|متعلَّق}}.
c) Make the مصدر {{label|مضاف}} to the إسم أَنَّ.
d) Ensure مضاف إليه is {{ruling|مجرور}}.

blocks.en: Note: The المصدر الصناعي can serve as a {{term|متعلَّق}}.
Maa (running head: الموصولات الحرفية، مَا)

items: ما is termed as {{term|المصدرية}} and {{term|المصدرية الظرفية}} because this ما is of 2 types.

They both connect to a جملة فعلية and جملة إسمية. They enter upon a verb and a مبتدا & خبر. However, the latter scenario is uncommon and non-unanimous amongst the grammarians. So, we will only deal with the جملة فعلية scenario here.
First, we will discuss ما المصدرية.
The verb can be a {{condition|ماضي}} verb or a {{condition|مضارع}} verb.
It will {{ruling|not impact}} the مضارع verb and make it منصوب like أَنْ did.
It will interpret the جملة فعلية into a {{ruling|مفرد}}.
The interpreted construction of the ما المصدرية will generally be a {{ruling|فاعل، مفعول به or مجرور}}.
The method of interpreting the sentence into a مفرد is the same as what was previously mentioned in أَنْ.
blocks.en: Bullet points on maa as written on the page (the page itself is in English).
Harf relatives: maa, masdariyyah (running head)
I dislike what the students neglect in their lessons.

items: a) Identify the مصدر.
b) Identify the نائب الفاعل/فاعل.
c) Extract the نائب الفاعل/فاعل if it's a ضمير.
d) Make the مصدر {{label|مضاف}} to the نائب الفاعل/فاعل.
e) Ensure {{label|مضاف إليه}} is {{ruling|مجرور}}.

blocks.en: The abandoning of the work (the interpreted masdar).
Maa al-masdariyyah al-zarfiyyah

items: The ما المصدرية الظرفية has a unique feature.
Along with interpreting the sentence into a compound, it also contains the meaning of {{ruling|time}}.
It signifies the period, the total time of conducting an action mentioned before it.
It expresses the meaning: {{ruling|"as long as"}} …
To express this meaning, the word {{term|"مُدّة"}} or something of a synonym is added at the beginning of the interpreted construction.
Since the ما المصدرية الظرفية signifies a time period, the interpreted construction of the ما المصدرية الظرفية will only be a {{ruling|ظرف متعلق}}.
The ما المصدرية الظرفية is sometimes termed as ما of {{term|ما دَامَ}}. This is because the ما in the فعل ناقص, ما دَامَ is this very ما.
The rest remains as it was with the ما المصدرية except that when the ما المصدرية الظرفية enters upon the مضارع verb, then the verb should contain a negation with the word {{condition|لَمْ}}.
